reviews.text: Unsure of what I was wanting with my backyard project, I was introduced to Sean and his team at Palm Construction where he took my idea, laid out the perfect plan and delivery it and more. I’m truly satisfied with the result and would recommend Sean and his team to anyone needing a project done whether big or small. Thanks again Sean! EXTREMELY HAPPY COSTUMER
reviews.author: Donald Hall

reviews.text: I recently hired Sean with Palm Construction for a siding project, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! From start to finish, their professionalism, attention to detail, and excellent communication made the entire process seamless. The quality of their workmanship is outstanding, and they truly went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. My home looks amazing, and I’ve already received compliments from neighbors! I highly recommend Sean from Palm Construction for anyone looking for top-notch siding work. Thank you for a job well done!
reviews.author: Shirin Amsellem

reviews.text: I would never use this company for attic reconstruction. They do not have the experience or alliance with any company for such workmanship.  They will lie that they have the ability to complete but would use unknown third parties who have never worked for them in the past. I fired this company after a deposit,  for not  walking away from this project, but due to their lofty goals, they were overly persistent. My project involved reinforcement , structural support and strength of the ceiling and attic floor. They foamed the ceiling with intentions to drywall without any ceiling support where it would shortly collapse. My construction engineer caught the problem in time. Be aware , they are not to be trusted with constructional projects. They refund my deposit but priorly, asked me to pay for the foam insulation even though it had to be removed for beams to be inserted. Be ware of this customer.
reviews.author: gloria lindsay

reviews.text: Daniel worked magic on our attic renovation! His idea to install skylights brought so much natural light into the space, making it feel airy and open. The insulation he recommended not only improved the temperature control but also made the room more comfortable year-round. Daniel’s approach to the design was spot-on, and we now have a gorgeous, functional space for our home office.
reviews.author: Mabel Fuentes

reviews.text: I never imagined a bathroom could feel this luxurious until Daniel transformed ours! 🛁✨ From the floor-to-ceiling tile work to the modern glass shower, he completely elevated the space. Daniel added a freestanding tub right by the window, giving us that “spa retreat” vibe, and even installed under-cabinet lighting that softly glows at night. It’s become a place to truly relax and unwind, and I couldn’t be happier with every detail. The whole process was smooth, and Daniel’s creative ideas made all the difference.
reviews.author: Ander Garcia

reviews.text: This company built a small deck a year and a half ago. It is now starting to show problems and when I called the 972 number, no one answers and no voicemail set up. So I called the 214 number, no one answered and I was able to leave a voicemail. So far, no call back. I dont even know what the warranty is because its not on ANY of the paperwork. It looked good at first( I really didnt know what I should look for)  They told me they did not need a city permit, but they did and they never got one. I checked with the city! The wood railings are NOT TREATED WOOD EITHER. The work took longer than they promised and now Im having problems. Do not use this company!
reviews.author: Kerry Banda

reviews.text: I would highly recommend Sean as the Project Manager for any of your home repairs. His service was excellent! I would use his services again.
reviews.author: Dorian Strong

reviews.text: Our kitchen renovation was a huge success, and we have Eli to thank for it! His attention to detail and commitment to quality ensured that everything went smoothly. The new layout and finishes have transformed our cooking space into a dream kitchen. Highly recommend his services!
reviews.author: Mariela Maldonado

data.summary: The review profile is mixed with significant red flags. The positive reviews are clustered in time and somewhat generic, while the negative reviews are highly specific and allege serious issues (structural incompetence, permit violations, ghosting). The low total review count and absence from other platforms is concerning for an established contractor. The negative reviews feel more authentic and detailed than the positive ones.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted around the same time (a year ago)
Generic, overly effusive praise in some 5-star reviews
Lack of specific negative details in some 5-star reviews
Low total review count (8) for a general contractor
No reviews on other major platforms (Angi, Houzz, Yelp)
authentic_signals: Specific project details in positive reviews (attic, bathroom, kitchen, siding)
Specific crew names mentioned (Sean, Daniel, Eli)
Negative reviews contain highly specific, credible complaints (permit, warranty, third parties, structural work)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) has substantive ratings. The HQ Google listing has no star ratings, only anonymous directory-style entries.
